item.title: Refactor order status into OrderStatus enum
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate's order status from String to a proper public enum. Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str with lowercase names; Display prints the same. Implement FromStr with type Err = public ParseStatusError implementing std::error::Error, and an error message that names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use enum throughout so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve all existing observable behavior (errors, report output and ordering, parsing). Run cargo test and commit the work on the local repository branch. Acceptance: implementation meets all API and lifecycle requirements, no status string literals outside src/status.rs, cargo test passes, commit created.

Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: introduce public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } and ParseStatusError, use the enum throughout the orders crate, and keep lowercase status serialization, lifecycle behavior, errors, report output/order, and parsing contracts intact. Original baseline was 51550ca05a04087d3f7d5a1880a45a6a12735437 (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf); the branch had no commits or diff beyond it. Added only integration characterization tests in tests/orders.rs, committed separately as af597d1995505c208c98f2839bc97716fa012015 (`test: characterize order status behavior`). Production code was not changed, and the final worktree is clean on the assigned branch.

Checks: before edits, `PATH=/home/mengsig/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/bin CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mengsig/.local/share/archon-bench/f164-9rntxe1v/archon-bench/work/20261120T085850Z/48bcb4f6296a71f2/.archon/data/cache/refactor-order-status/items/qi_01M7W75FHAJFCW5NSCWNMK1NV6/cargo-target cargo test` passed (3 integration tests). After tests were added, the same command passed (7 integration tests, 0 unit/doc tests). `PATH=/home/mengsig/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/bin cargo fmt --all -- --check` failed because existing production files src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, and src/shipping.rs are not rustfmt-formatted; the new test file was formatted directly with rustfmt. No README, Makefile, CI, lint, or type-check instructions were present. Final checked tree: 15355189515f2477b2c82ac97375acfae946fc20.

Public surface inventory: crate root exports Order; public modules are billing, order, report, shipping. Order exposes id, customer, total_cents, status plus new/cancel/is_open. Billing exposes pay/outstanding_cents; shipping exposes ship/ready_to_ship; report exposes status_counts/to_line/from_line. No CLI or external wire/file interface exists; report CSV line is the observable format. Characterization pins normal lifecycle, cancellation while pending/paid and repeat cancellation, illegal/repeated operation error strings, outstanding totals, ship-ready input ordering, lexical status-count ordering, report line formatting including current unescaped comma behavior, round-trip, parser field-count/id/total/status errors and validation order, rejected leading whitespace in status, and trailing newline trimming. The brief allows the status field and status-related APIs to change to the enum, while requiring observable behavior to remain stable; no other allowed contract exceptions were stated. Remaining gaps for the refactorer: the new ParseStatusError display wording and every can_transition_to truth-table case have no baseline counterpart because those APIs do not exist yet. Preserve the established report parse errors and raw `unknown status {:?}` formatting. No feedback was provided.
